title: Free AI Email Writer |  Generate Marketing Emails in Seconds

facts.fact: HubSpot labels its AI Email Writer product as in Beta.
facts.quote: Beta HubSpot's AI email writing software boosts your productivity.

facts.fact: HubSpot states that no credit card is required to use the AI Email Writer.
facts.quote: No credit card required. Free and premium features available.

facts.fact: HubSpot states that both free and premium features are available for the AI Email Writer.
facts.quote: No credit card required. Free and premium features available.

facts.fact: HubSpot's own claim is that its AI Email Writer can generate hundreds of sales email drafts in minutes.
facts.quote: With HubSpot’s AI email writer, you can generate hundreds of sales email drafts in minutes.

facts.fact: HubSpot states that the AI email writer is built into its marketing and sales tools so users can draft, send, track, and analyze emails in one place.
facts.quote: The software is built into HubSpot’s marketing and sales tools, so you can easily draft, send, track, and analyze your email efforts in one place.

facts.fact: HubSpot states that premium versions of its free features are offered through its enterprise software.
facts.quote: Get premium versions of all our free features — and much more!
